subject.title: Alibaba Token Plan (Personal/Solo, Singapore ap-southeast-1) — quota not parsed; auth succeeds but body parser returns null

question: Should Singapore Personal/Solo Token Plan be supported as a separate Qwen Cloud provider variant, rather than extending the existing Alibaba Team-edition subscription request?
rationale: The canonical report indicates a distinct host, gateway action, response shape, and 5-hour/weekly quota semantics, so choosing the permanent provider boundary requires maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt a separate Personal/Solo variant
options.body: Track the existing Team flow separately and add a dedicated Qwen Cloud Personal/Solo request and parser after redacted live-payload validation.

options.title: Keep Team-only scope
options.body: Document that the existing provider supports Team edition only and surface an explicit unsupported-Personal/Solo state rather than null quota values.

recommendation.title: Adopt a separate Personal/Solo variant
recommendation.body: Track the existing Team flow separately and add a dedicated Qwen Cloud Personal/Solo request and parser after redacted live-payload validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a provider-scope and user-facing product-boundary decision for the repository owner.
